This photograph captures a dimly lit, traditional architectural structure, likely part of a temple or historical building. The focus is on an ornate, dark wooden frame with intricate carvings and geometric patterns. The upper part of the frame features two large, scallop-shaped elements with delicate, lace-like designs. Below, a rectangular opening reveals a shadowy interior with more detailed carvings and a glimpse of greenery outside through a partially visible window. The lighting is low, creating a moody, almost nocturnal atmosphere with deep shadows and subtle highlights. The background includes blurred, dark green foliage, adding to the sense of depth and mystery. The texture of the wood is smooth but intricately decorated, with the carvings providing a contrast of light and shadow. No watermark is present in the image. The overall style is traditional and historical, with a focus on architectural detail and natural elements.

This photograph captures a vertical slice of a traditional Asian architectural structure. The upper portion features dark, overhanging eaves with intricate, textured patterns. Below, a black, ornate wooden bracket is silhouetted against a bright blue sky, creating a striking contrast. The middle section of the image is dominated by a large, green, ribbed leaf, its texture and curvature adding a natural element to the scene. The bottom left corner includes a small, out-of-focus branch with delicate leaves, adding depth. The lighting is natural, with a clear, bright sky illuminating the leaf and bracket, while the eaves remain in shadow. There is no visible watermark. The overall composition balances natural and architectural elements, with a focus on texture and contrast.

This photograph features a dark, moody indoor setting with a prominent black, geometric-patterned wall in the lower center. The pattern consists of bold, intersecting lines forming abstract shapes. To the left, there is a large, green, corrugated leaf, adding a natural texture. On the right, a green vine with heart-shaped leaves extends into the frame, creating a contrast against the dark background. The lighting is dim, with shadows adding depth and a mysterious atmosphere. The top of the image shows a draped, textured fabric in shades of gray and blue, slightly illuminated. The overall composition blends natural and abstract elements, with a focus on contrasting textures and colors. No watermark is present in the image.

This photograph captures a close-up view of an ornately carved, dark brown wooden door. The carvings feature intricate, swirling patterns and floral motifs, with a central vertical panel showcasing a detailed, symmetrical floral design. The door's frame is rectangular with a slightly glossy finish, and the carvings are set within a grid-like pattern. Soft, natural light from the right side illuminates the door, casting gentle shadows that enhance the texture and depth of the carvings. In the background, there is a blurry blue sky with some green foliage, suggesting the door is outdoors. The lighting creates a serene, somewhat moody atmosphere. There is no watermark present in the image.

The photograph features WangLP, a young person with long, straight, black hair styled in a traditional updo, adorned with a black fabric wrap. WangLP's face is illuminated by warm, golden light, highlighting their smooth skin and subtle, natural makeup with a focus on red lips. They wear a dark green, satin-like kimono with a black inner garment. The background is a gradient of deep blue, transitioning to a lighter blue at the top, with delicate green vines climbing the left side of the wall. The lighting creates a soft, glowing effect on WangLP's face, contrasting with the darker blue background. The top right corner shows part of a blue-green leafy plant. There is no watermark present in the image. The overall style is a blend of traditional and contemporary, with a focus on elegant simplicity and natural beauty. The photograph has a slightly warm, ethereal quality due to the lighting and color contrasts.

This photograph features a partial view of WangLP, with their face partially visible on the left side, showing long, dark hair styled in a simple bun. WangLP's skin is illuminated by a warm, soft light, contrasting with the cool blue and green hues of the background. The background consists of a textured wall with a subtle pattern of green vines and leaves, adding a natural, organic feel. Overlapping the wall are large, vibrant leaves in shades of blue and green, creating a layered, almost surreal effect. On the right, a wooden doorframe with a greenish tint is adorned with a small, climbing vine with light green leaves, adding a touch of natural texture. The lighting in the image is soft and warm, highlighting WangLP's face and the natural elements. There is no watermark present in the image. The overall composition combines elements of nature with a subtle, modern aesthetic.

This photograph captures a close-up of a dark wooden frame, adorned with intricate carvings, partially obscured by a misty, blue-green fog. The fog appears to be moving, creating a sense of depth and motion. The lighting is dim, with a cool blue tint that enhances the misty effect. The wooden frame, located in the upper left corner, features a decorative pattern, adding a touch of elegance to the scene. The texture of the fog is delicate and feathery, contrasting with the solid, carved wood. There are no visible watermarks in the image. The overall mood is mysterious and ethereal, with the interplay of light and mist adding a surreal quality to the photograph.

This is a photograph featuring a close-up of draped fabric in shades of teal and dark green, illuminated by a dim, moody light source. The fabric has a smooth texture with subtle folds and creases, creating a sense of depth and movement. In the background, there is a wooden lattice structure partially visible, adding a rustic element to the composition. A small, fuzzy green pillow is positioned in the lower right corner, providing a soft, contrasting texture against the smooth fabric. The lighting casts a gentle shadow across the fabric, enhancing the folds and adding a sense of mystery. The overall color palette is dominated by dark greens and teals, with a slight glow from the light source. There is no visible watermark in the image. The photograph has a serene, almost ethereal quality due to the soft lighting and the delicate textures of the fabric and pillow.

This photograph features WangLP, partially visible, leaning out of a window. WangLP's hand, adorned in a dark green, long-sleeved garment, rests on the window's brown wooden frame. The window is rectangular and has a slightly worn texture. The background reveals a dimly lit interior with a dark-colored couch or bed, barely visible through the glass. Outside the window, there is a lush, green fern-like plant, its delicate leaves and stems creating a soft, textured foreground. The lighting is low and warm, casting subtle shadows and enhancing the rich green hues of the plant and WangLP's garment. The photograph has a moody, intimate atmosphere, with a focus on the contrast between the indoor and outdoor elements. There is no watermark present in the image.

根据画面人物人脸所在方格位置选择分割方式：
横向3x竖向3方格分割
横向3x竖向2方格分割
横向2x竖向3方格分割

步数：可以4-8步；
降噪：脸部画面整体占比较小且崩坏降噪开到0.2左右，
正常可以0.16-0.18保持一致性

A portrait photograph captures two elegant young Asian women standing closely side by side, radiating grace and poise. They are adorned in exquisite traditional Chinese cheongsam dresses, featuring intricate embroidery and long, flowing skirts with striking thigh-high slits that reveal their thighs. Soft, diffused natural light highlights the intricate details of their dresses and illuminates their gentle smiles, with a subtle blush on their cheeks and long dark hair cascading down their shoulders. The background is a softly blurred, antique wooden screen with ornate carvings, creating a serene and timeless atmosphere.

高清人像，人文摄影，哈苏摄影，大师级非常规独特构图，暗黑背景，营造蒙太奇效果。画面有胶片细腻的颗粒，通过冷暖色系碰撞来表达辩证冲突，传递丰富的情绪。目光 眼神 雕花窗棂，斑驳的墙，缠枝纹，饕餮纹，蕉叶纹 宝相纹。磨砂肌理绘画，高级美感和模糊效果完美融合，插画风格，色调以浓郁且层次丰富的蓝绿色为主。大量类似阴生植物的，用深浅不同的蓝绿，营造出神秘、静谧氛围，仿佛把人物轻柔包裹 。人物形象简洁，黑长发、绿衣服，与背景色调和谐相融，整体画面带着朦胧又文艺的质感，像在讲述一个藏于自然角落的安静故事，给人宁静又略带遐想的视觉感受。，笔触有纹理感，呈现出一种质朴且富有生机的森林或自然氛围，油画风，用色彩和造型传递独特的生活或自然情境 。
